title: Realtime kanban board
name: kanban
prompt: A kanban board for my small team: boards with columns (To do, Doing, Done by default, editable), cards with title, description, assignee and due date, drag and drop between columns, and live updates: when one person moves a card, everyone else sees it move without reloading. Comments on cards. Managers can create and archive boards; members can create and move cards.

answers: Up to 10 people. Use the sign-in Flagship gives us.
Live updates are a must, the rest can be simple.

edits: Add labels with colours to cards and a filter by label.
Show an activity log per board: who moved or edited which card and when.
Add WIP limits per column: a column turns red when it has more cards than its limit.
